import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 31;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int n;
    static long[][] mat = new long[MAX][MAX];

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] t = new long[MAX][MAX];

        void setIdentity() {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    t[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void multiply(Matrix b) {
            long[][] temp = new long[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        temp[i][k] += this.t[i][j] * b.t[j][k] % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    this.t[i][j] = temp[i][j] % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m_in = sc.nextLong();
        int k_in = sc.nextInt();

        long mVal = m_in;
        int kVal = k_in;

        List<Long> digitsArr = new ArrayList<>();
        while (mVal != 0) {
            digitsArr.add(mVal % kVal);
            mVal /= kVal;
        }

        n = kVal + 1;

        Matrix base = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < kVal; i++) {
            base.t[i][(i + 1) % kVal] = 1;
        }
        base.t[kVal][kVal] = 1;

        Matrix identity = new Matrix();
        identity.setIdentity();

        for (int i = 0; i <= kVal; i++) {
            base.t[0][i] = 1;
            base.t[i][i] = 1;
        }

        List<Matrix> dMat = new ArrayList<>();
        Matrix firstMat = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                firstMat.t[i][j] = identity.t[i][j];
            }
        }
        firstMat.multiply(base);
        dMat.add(firstMat);

        for (int i = 1; i < digitsArr.size(); i++) {
            Matrix prev = dMat.get(i - 1);
            Matrix newMat = new Matrix();
            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    newMat.t[r][c] = prev.t[r][c];
                }
            }
            for (int _ = 0; _ < kVal; _++) {
                newMat.multiply(newMat);
            }
            newMat.multiply(base);
            dMat.add(newMat);
        }

        long[] res = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = 1;
        }

        for (int idx = digitsArr.size() - 1; idx >= 0; idx--) {
            long digit = digitsArr.get(idx);
            for (int _ = 0; _ < digit; _++) {
                long[] pw = new long[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    pw[i] = 0;
                }
                Matrix currentMat = dMat.get(idx);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        pw[j] += res[i] * currentMat.t[i][j] % MOD;
                    }
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    res[i] = pw[i] % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(res[kVal]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
